dinners.name: Stuffed pepper skillet (unstuffed peppers)
dinners.note: Use a GF-labelled beef broth and swap the Worcestershire for 2 tsp GF tamari (Canadian Lea & Perrins uses malt vinegar). Check the Italian seasoning and shredded cheese labels. Use 1 lb of the ground beef; full recipe = dinner + 2 lunches.

dinners.name: Chickpea & sweet potato curry
dinners.note: Naturally GF and vegetarian; check the curry powder label. Halve it: 1 large sweet potato, 1/2 of the 796 ml chickpeas, 1 can tomatoes, 1 can coconut milk (keep the rest for leftovers/lunch). Serve over rice.

dinners.name: Coconut curry shrimp
dinners.note: Substitute GF tamari for the soy sauce (the recipe's own GF swap) and check the red curry paste label (Thai Kitchen is GF). Use the 300 g shrimp (~2/3 recipe) and 1/2 yellow onion instead of the shallot. Serve over rice with lime.

dinners.name: One-pan roasted chicken with fall vegetables
dinners.note: GF as written (check the balsamic label). Halve it: 4 bone-in thighs, ~1/2 lb each squash, mini potatoes, carrots and Brussels sprouts. About 10 min prep + 25–30 min roast at 400°F + 2 min broil.

dinners.name: Beef & cabbage stir-fry
dinners.note: Substitute GF tamari for the soy and dark soy sauces, use GF hoisin/oyster sauce or replace both with 1 tsp honey + 1 extra tsp tamari, and use water instead of broth. Halve it (1/2 lb beef). Green cabbage works in place of napa. Serve over rice.

dinners.name: Maple mustard salmon
dinners.note: Naturally GF; check the Dijon label. Use 2 fillets (~3/4 lb) and halve the glaze; dried thyme is fine. Roast the rest of the mini potatoes and the broccoli alongside at 400°F.

groceries.name: Regular ground beef, family size
groceries.note: Sunday skillet (1 lb) + Thursday stir-fry (1/2 lb). Regular, not lean: drain the fat. Freeze any extra.

groceries.note: Wednesday sheet pan (4 thighs). Ad is bone-in; freeze extras.
